requirements.evidence:
This goes beyond what Derek could verify. In the `mktemp -d` copy, I copied `pi-jefferson@0.14.0`'s own `extensions/jefferson` out of `node_modules` and wired its `createRegistrationListener`, `createRegistry`, `createProviderFields` and `createFaultLedger` to pi's real `createEventBus()`. I then drove taiknr's real `createJeffersonBusAdapter` and `createInstrumentsPublisher` through `sessionStarted`, `started`/`finished`, `reportRecalled`, `requestBuilt`, a priced `responseReceived`, `settled`, an errored response, `compacted` and `treeJumped`.

- The fault ledger delivered no notice.
- Every adapted resolver returned text. For example, `$savedDollarsRequest` was `-0.0114`, `$approx` was `~`, and `$bar` was `null` with window 0.

The scratch files were removed. Joel's live look still covers the TUI rendering.

findings.finding:
The request registrar's test file has none of the switch-off pair that §13 requires of every registrar test. `redgreen-derek.md` Gaps 1 and 13.2 single this registrar out as the one whose pair throws on the `model` getter.

The scenario *Every publishing event with the switch off* ("no instrument reading is evaluated") is therefore unproven for `context_with_system`. A registrar that evaluates `readRequest(event, ctx)` before handing it to `holder.current()` still passes all 523 tests. That is the eager host read ZO-S1-1 ruled out.

Task 13.2 is ticked without this deliverable.

*Interfaces* ("per pair, the newest assistant entry"), 10.1 ("the seeds are each pair's newest valid sample") and `context-figures` *A resumed session seeds k* ("seeded from the newest such response") all name the newest valid reply. No seed case has two valid replies for one pair, so dropping `.reverse()` passes all 523 tests. That mutation seeds every resumed session from its oldest reply.

The code is right; the ticked task's named assertion is missing.

findings.location: src/use-cases/instruments-publisher.ts, `sessionStarted`: the six assignments after `table = seedTable(readings.seeds)` (`pending`, `baseline`, `reportedRecall`, `unchargedSpend`, `savedTokensSinceStart`, `savedDollarsSinceStart`)
findings.finding:
Derek's own call. These six assignments reset state for a second `sessionStarted` on one publisher. RDY2-5 settled that this is not a case: `instruments-session-start.ts` builds a fresh publisher at every session start, and nothing can call the publisher before `install()`.

The code is unreachable state handling that no test covers. Deleting all six leaves all 523 tests green. *A reload or a resume starts the total again* rests on the fresh factory (ruling 12), not on this method.
findings.required_change:
Delete the six assignments. `table = seedTable(readings.seeds)` stays.

I ran the deletion in my copy, together with findings 1 and 2: `npm run check` green, 37 files, 526 tests.
